summary: This plugin provides DSH memory-management tools using OCR-rendered memory entries, including storing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and checking memory status and metrics.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a memory/context tool for DSH agents, as it defines OCR1-style memory tools to store, retrieve, update, list, forget, and inspect memory entries, with a rendering pipeline that turns text into image-based segments and uses age-based resolution/active-recall behavior. The manifest and README explicitly expose this as a DeepSeek-OCR memory system, and configuration is centered on OCR endpoints, rendering paths, and memory store settings, indicating user-facing memory management rather than general coding, UI, or search utilities.
